messages.content: Return valid JSON only. Do not hide the answer in reasoning.

{"request": "You are an independent ICLR security researcher. Return only JSON with keys verdict, novelty_0_to_10, title, one_sentence_claim, threat_model, exact_operation, carrier, mechanism_metric, short_gate, defense, core_tasks, overlap_risks, rationale. We need a broad world-model security mechanism after these failures: TD-MPC2 legal cascade only harmed one source-seed/task direction; MBRL-Lib sampler, boundary-state provenance, ensemble synchronization, and temporal phase source all failed selective invariants; WorldAgen goal/TTT screens lack closed-loop success; WorldEvolver/ScienceWorld semantic rule errors did not lower three full-task successes. A new candidate may change the trust boundary or learning protocol (for example multi-model composition, model checkpoint sharing, self-generated imagination, or verifier/actor interaction), but must still use an existing local carrier, have a 2-minute native gate, a mechanism-specific observable, and a clean repair. Avoid generic poisoning, backdoors, prompt injection, adversarial examples, OOD, negative transfer, catastrophic forgetting, rollout compounding, uncertainty collapse, sampler coupling, goal leakage, Jacobian/action-desensitization, retrieval recency, or ordinary automation bias. Aim for one large sentence and novelty 7-7.5 with multiple core-task scale-up. Return REJECT_ALL if no candidate truly clears this boundary."}
